baseline.method: Explicitly corrected independent pymaginverse oracle, degree3, five iterations

threshold_provenance: Independent unmodified and minimal physics-corrected oracle captures precede extraction. Corrected oracle vs SciPy-only extracted implementation differs at approximately 1e-15 relative scale. Nonzero 1e-7 dynamic-range tolerance covers numerical backend variation, with each of15 epoch/components and spline coefficients scored separately.
observation_consistency_definition: sqrt(mean(((observed - predicted)/provided_sigma)^2)) per F/I/D type; angular quantities use degrees and declination residual wraps into [-180,180]. Public data only; predicted from submitted spline coefficients using independent potential gradient and geometric ellipsoid conversion.
